basis: The chart displays 'Number of COVID-19 patients hospitalized' with an inverted y-axis (0 at the top, 8000 at the bottom). The blue line moves from the top-left (near 0) to the bottom-right (below 8000) as the dates progress from Feb 24 to Mar 14. This visual movement corresponds to a rapid increase in the number of hospitalized patients. The slope of the line becomes significantly steeper in the later dates, indicating a surge in demand. This supports routing to surge-capacity planning.
option_label: Route to hospital surge-capacity planning guidance for rapidly increasing COVID-19 inpatient demand
